WHEREAS, CharlesE.Bales has requested that his property located at3618Charles Street,
more specifically described as Lots6and7, Robitaille Subdivision, and all of that part of Robitaille
Court and Wills Road adjacent to Lots6and7, and thatportion of Charles Street from the west
right-of-wayline of Wills Road easterly135feet, Laramie County, Wyoming, be annexed into the
City of Cheyenne because his private sewer system has failed and poses a health, safety and welfare
risk; and
WHEREAS, the annexation of the property will providefor hookup to the City's sewer
system and there by protect thehealth, safety and welfare ofthe persons residing in the area; and
WHEREAS, Mr.Bales is presently unable tofinance the construction of allthe corresponding
improvements required for annexation; and
WHEREAS, Chapter33-55of the Code of the City of Cheyenne, as amended by Ordinance
No.3373, expressly authorizes the City of Cheyenne to enter into an agreement with an owner of
property in the 201 study area to defer the required off-site improvements set forth in section33-57;
and
WHEREAS, Mr.Bales’property meets the requirements of Ordinance No.3373; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne wishes to enterinto an agreement with Mr.Bales todefer
construction of the public improvements.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OFCHEYENNE, WYOMING, that the Mayor and the City Clerk are authorized to execute an
agreement with Charles E.Bales to defer the off-site improvements of section33-57 so that his
property mayreceive City sewer services contingent uponfinal approval of the annexation of his
property.

AGREEMENT BETWEEN
THE CITY OF CHEYENNE AND CHARLES E.BALES
DATE:2-2Y-0
This Agreement is made and entered intoby and between the City of Cheyenne, a
municipality organized and existing under thelaws of the State of Wyoming, whose
address is 2101 O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82001 ("the City"), and Charles E.
Bales, whose address is 3618 Charles Street, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82009 (“Bales").
RECITALS
A.Bales is the current owner of property (*the property") which is contiguous
to, but not annexed to, the City. The property is more specifically described as follows:
Lots 6 and 7, Robitaille Subdivision, andall of that part of
Robitaille Court and Wills Road adjacent to Lots6 and 7, and
that portion of Charles Street from the west right-of-wayline
of Wills Road easterly 135feet, Laramie County, Wyoming.
B.Bales desires to annex the property to the City in order to obtain City sewer
service becausehis private sewer system hasfailed.However, Bales is not currently able
tofinance the construction of street improvements including street, sidewalk, curb and
gutter, which arerequired by the City as a condition precedent to annexation and
availability of City sewer service.
C. The City recognizes that it is important to annex Bales' property because
such action will resolve a serious health and safety problem, diminish county pockets and
add residents to the tax rolls of the City.
D.Bales acknowledges that he is obligated to pay all costs associated with the
construction of street improvements including street, sidewalk, curb andgutter, upon the
City's request.He also acknowledges that the improvements will be made when his
property is sold.
THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promises and covenants contained in
this agreement, the parties agree as follows:
I.
CITY'S OBLIGATIONS.
The City hereby agrees to annex Bales’property and defer construction of the
above-described improvements in exchange for Bales’promise that he will make the
orwhen the property is sold.

ⅡI.BALES'OBLIGATIONS.
Bales agrees to make street improvements when requested to do so by the City
Engineer.
When Bales or his heirs sell the property, street, sidewalk, curb and gutter
improvements must be made or sufficient funds must be escrowed for this purpose within
thirty (30) days of the sale, which includes entering into a contract for deed or similar
arrangement.Innoevent shall improvement monies es crowed ever become property of
the City of Cheyenne; such monies shall either be used for the improvements described
herein, or be returned to the Mr.Bales or his heirs and devisees along with any interest
earned.
III.GENERAL PROVISIONS.
A.Applicable Law.The construction, interpretation and enforcement of this
Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Wyoming.The courts of the State
of Wyoming shall have jurisdiction over anyaction arisingout of this Agreement and over
the parties, and thevenue shall be the First Judicial District, Laramie County，Wyoming.
B.Entirety of Agreement. This Agreement, consisting of three (3) pages,
represents the entire and integrated agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior
negotiations, representations and agreements, whether written or oral. None of terms of
this Agreement maybe waived ormodified to any extent.
C.Sovereign Immunity.The City of Cheyenne does not waive its sovereign
immunity by entering into this Agreement, and fully retains all immunities and defenses
provided by law withrespect toany action based on or occurring as a result of this
Agreement. Bales further agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the City, its officers,
to comply with theterms and conditions of this Agreement.
D.Binding Nature of Agreement.The terms and conditions contained in this
Agreement shall be a covenant runningwith the land and shall extend toandbe binding
upon Bales, his heirs, devisees, personal representatives, successors, assigns and any
subsequent purchaser, lessee orholder of a contract for deed on the property.
E.Encumbrance.This Agreement shall be put of record by the Laramie
County Clerk of Deeds and shall operate as an encumbrance on the property.The amount
of the encumbrance shall be actual costs of construction as determined by the City
Engineer or one hundred and fifty percent (150%）of the minimum estimated cost of the
improvements on that date if actual costs are not determined by the time of sale.
